correctness.rationale: For every n>=4 complex uniform rank-three arrangement, the local Möbius automorphism z_j=y_j/(1-alpha_j y_j)=u/L_j(v,w) sends the coordinate vertex germ exactly to the cone spanned by Q_j=product of all but the j-th binary factor. Pairwise distinct roots imply the n-1 homogeneous degree-(n-2) forms Q_j are a basis of H^0(P1,O(n-2)). Thus the completed local ring really is C[[s,t]]^{mu_{n-2}}, not merely tangent-cone equivalent. The minimal exceptional curve is P1 with self-intersection -r; toric class group Z/r, multiplicity r, embedding dimension r+1, canonical index r/gcd(r,2), mld 2/r follow. Checked n=4..8 all vertices by separately constructed exact Vandermonde binary-form determinants; universality comes from symbolic evaluation, not finite checks. Boundaries n=4 is A1 canonical and Gorenstein; n>=5 noncanonical.
